title: ACXD Context Variable
description: Contract schema for workspace-level ACXD context variables. The public docs document flow-scoped variables as {name, type}; workspace-level variables additionally accept a JSON Schema. Kept permissive on undocumented fields by design.

type.$comment: SDK ContextVariableType (enums.d.ts): BOOLEAN | NUMBER | STRING | TEXT — the builder emits 'string' by default
